tables.name: Two-sided limit approach table
tables.notes: Use uneven spacing when useful; do not make the target value obvious by exact equality.

tables.name: Function/derivative value table
tables.notes: Useful for tangent, inverse-derivative, and representation-connection tasks.

tables.name: Motion table
tables.notes: Include units in headers; choose intervals that support sign/direction reasoning.

tables.name: Contextual rate table
tables.notes: Use nonuniform time intervals when trapezoidal/accumulation reasoning is intended.

tables.name: Related-rates instant table
tables.notes: Separate what is known at the instant from what is constant for all time.

tables.name: Derivative sign chart
tables.notes: Do not label extrema/concavity when students are supposed to infer them.

tables.name: Nonuniform partition table
tables.notes: Explicitly support left/right/trapezoid choices with unequal Δx.

tables.name: Accumulation-function evidence table
tables.notes: Useful for connecting area, sign, and accumulation behavior.

tables.name: Derivative/antiderivative relation table
tables.notes: Can ask for change in F without requiring an explicit antiderivative formula.

tables.name: Slope-field sample grid
tables.notes: Data structure for building a slope field; downstream visual should be a real field, not this raw table, unless the table itself is the task.

tables.name: Differential-equation initial-condition record
tables.notes: Keep the initial condition clearly separate from the general differential equation.

tables.name: Area-between-curves intersection table
tables.notes: Use only when numerical intersections are part of the supplied information or calculator work.

tables.name: Cross-section dimension table
tables.notes: Students should still construct the area function unless the Assessment Plan/task purpose says otherwise.

tables.name: Disc/washer radius organizer
tables.notes: Measure each radius as a distance to the axis; avoid answer-revealing labels in student figures.

rule: Render actual HTML tables/data displays in student materials when tabular structure matters; never expose raw Python/JSON arrays as the student representation.
